title: [AUG-91] User preferences persistence system with Settings page
why_we_need_this: Every session launch, users must re-select language, mic device, system audio toggle, recording mode, and other settings. These choices should persist as defaults across sessions. Decided in brainstorm AUG-88: auto-save last choice + dedicated Settings page for overrides/resets, server-side JSON file storage, all non-trivial preferences.
acceptance_criteria:
## Server — Preferences API
- [ ] `server/data/user-preferences.json` stores all preferences as a flat JSON object
- [ ] `GET /api/preferences` returns the current preferences (empty object `{}` if file doesn't exist — client applies defaults)
- [ ] `PATCH /api/preferences` accepts partial JSON, merges into existing file, returns the merged result
- [ ] If the file doesn't exist on first PATCH, it is created automatically

## Preferences Schema (all fields optional, client defaults when absent)
- [ ] `language` — string, default `"auto"` (transcription language)
- [ ] `micDeviceId` — string, default `"default"` (saved mic device ID)
- [ ] `systemAudio` — boolean, default `false` (capture system audio toggle)
- [ ] `recordingMode` — `"default"` | `"live"`, default `"default"`
- [ ] `liveEngine` — `"local"` | `"groq"`, default `"local"`
- [ ] `audioBoost` — boolean, default `false`
- [ ] `retranscriptionLanguage` — string | null, default `null`
- [ ] `praxisProjectPath` — string | null, default `null` (last Send to Praxis target)
- [ ] `sidebarCollapsed` — boolean, default `false`
- [ ] `sessionSortOrder` — `"newest"` | `"oldest"` | `"alphabetical"`, default `"newest"`
- [ ] `skipStopConfirmation` — boolean, default `false` (skip "Are you sure?" on Stop)
- [ ] `skipClearConfirmation` — boolean, default `false` (skip "Are you sure?" on Clear All)

## Client — Auto-Save Behavior
- [ ] When the user changes language, mic, system audio, recording mode, live engine, or boost — the new value is auto-saved via `PATCH /api/preferences`
- [ ] On app load, `GET /api/preferences` is called and the returned values are used as initial state for all controls
- [ ] When the saved `micDeviceId` is not found in available devices, fall back to system default AND show a brief dismissable notice: "Preferred mic not found — using system default"

## Client — Settings Page
- [ ] A Settings page/modal accessible from the main UI (e.g., gear icon or menu item)
- [ ] Displays all persisted preferences with current values
- [ ] Each preference is editable from this page
- [ ] "Reset to defaults" button clears the preferences file and restores all defaults
- [ ] Settings page follows the existing Necron/brutalist design system (0 border-radius, theme tokens, monospace where applicable)

## Constraints
- [ ] No database — file-based only, consistent with August's local-first architecture
- [ ] Theme toggle remains in localStorage (already working, do not migrate)
- [ ] All preferences are optional — the app must work identically to today if the preferences file is missing or empty
